accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All cards, tab triggers, modal inputs, and CTA buttons MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='resumen-360-card-bautismo', data-testid='bautismo-modal-submit')
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA ratio 4.5:1 or APCA standards met. Dark navy text (#101D36) on light gold/cream backgrounds (#F4EBCF, #F7F5EF).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL 16 cards in Perfil 360 are functional and clickable with real navigation or dialog modals.
ELIMINATE 'No disponible' / 'module_unavailable' statuses for implemented modules in Profile360Summary.js.
Implement real status handling for Membresía (person_memberships), Bautismo (editable state, date, place, minister, notes), and Bienvenida (welcome_party stage).
Keep existing brand aesthetics intact: Navy (#101D36), Gold (#C8A951), Warm Light Gray (#F7F5EF), Spectral serif headers, IBM Plex Sans body.
Ensure responsive layout on mobile and desktop viewports.
Preserve access control checks (permissions and role capabilities) when opening sensitive detail drawers or tabs.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Every interactive element, tab, card, and button must include data-testid.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or dropdowns. Always use backdrop blur and high opacity white/slate backgrounds.
